# 00000007878

**HCA-08 ★** — source: 248_高阶范畴与同调代数II.md

**English.** Definition: The higher heights of the chromatic nullstellensatz: the Zariski closure B_h of the prime spectrum of the thick subcategory generated by automorphisms of the Morava E-theory spectrum E_h. Conjecture: The Krull dimension of B_h is h+1 (height h plus integral dimension 1); and the closed points of B_h correspond one-to-one with height h+1 Anderson-dual points, the correspondence given by the Toda reduction of Ravenel's v_h-periodic self maps, compatible in the h to infinity limit with the Hopkins-Smith thick subcategory classification of the sphere spectrum. (chromatic closure dimension h+1)

**中文。** 定义：chromatic nullstellensatz 的更高高度：Morava E-理论谱 E_h 的自同构在稳定范畴中生成的厚子范畴的素谱的 Zariski 闭包 B_h。猜想：B_h 的 Krull 维数为 h+1（高度 h 加整维 1）；且 B_h 的闭点与高度 h+1 的Anderson-dual 点一一对应，对应映射由 Ravenel 的 v_h-周期自映射的 Toda 约化给出，该对应在 h→∞ 的极限与球谱的 thick 子范畴分类（Hopkins–Smith）相容。
